(defn nested-row-map-sum ^double [nested-rows row]
  (reduce-kv (fn [sum _ payload]
               (+ (double sum) (first-payload-value payload)))
             0.0
             (get nested-rows row)))

(defn nested-row-only-col-sum ^double [nested-rows col]
  (reduce-kv (fn [sum _ row-map]
               (if-let [payload (get row-map col)]
                 (+ (double sum) (first-payload-value payload))
                 sum))
             0.0
             nested-rows))
